summary: Fixed all five harness defects; VM gate green; corpus reports 255 failures across 201 cases in existing product-bug categories.
body:
Changed [sr_core_corpus.rs](/home/admin/src/filmcraft-wt/corpus/crates/interchange/tests/sr_core_corpus.rs) and [findings.json](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/findings.json). Product code and fixtures are unchanged. No commits. No public API changes or borrowed code.

The harness now preserves validity expectations when diagnostic assertions are unsupported, round-trips every successful strict and lenient import, requires exactly 10,000 imported clips in the sibling regression, matches known failures by stage and exact normalized diagnostic-code set, and gives both Python calls a 120-second deadline with kill/reap. No new specification ambiguities arose.

The pinned corpus produced:

- 1,343 cases; 816 strict and 860 lenient imports.
- 344 strict refusals as expected.
- 1,676 exports and oracle checks—all schema checks passed.
- 3,352 successful re-imports; clip-count failures remain reported separately.
- Zero product panics or Python timeouts.
- 232 unsupported diagnostic-assertion skips; no validity expectations skipped.
- 255 failure records across 201 cases, including 26 previously hidden cases. No new failure categories.

Every failing case, fixture, source location, cause and proposed fix is recorded in findings.json. The existing categories remain:

| Category | Cases | Product location, cause and proposed fix |
|---|---:|---|
| Fractional depth | 11 | `scene/resolve.rs:1275`: applies integer stacking-z parsing to geometric depth; restrict it to applicable 2D nodes. |
| Material overrides | 6 | `scene/import/overlay.rs:122`: misses string-encoded material references; include their dependency closure. |
| External expressions | 122 | `scene/import/overlay.rs:49`: rejects sibling dependencies; preserve a bounded enclosing composition and its clocks. |
| Geodesic cameras | 18 | `scene/import/overlay.rs:152`: loses the implicit black-hole dependency; retain the required 3D context. |
| Voxel palettes | 14 | `scene/import/overlay.rs:122`: misses palette material IDs; collect their dependencies. |
| Linked audio | 18 | `scene/export.rs:407`: video audio and explicit audioMix duplicate clips on re-import; serialize each audio source once. |
| Generated IDs | 12 | `scene/import/overlay.rs:43`: requires generated IDs to exist in the DOM; preserve generators and defer build-time references. |

Locations above are under `crates/interchange/src/`. The eighth ignored regression is `scene_corpus_10000_siblings_export` at test line 499: `scene/export.rs:432` charges default effect parameters against the export budget. Separate traversal and emitted-content budgets or align import/export limits. Its explicit run verified both imports contained exactly 10,000 clips, then failed because zero exports completed instead of two.

TDD evidence:

- `harness_unported_expectation_keeps_validity`: failed because unsupported codes dropped validity → passed.
- `harness_roundtrips_both_import_modes`: exported `1 != 2` → passed.
- `harness_known_failure_rejects_extra_codes_and_other_stages`: hid `MOV2 + NEW` → passed.
- `harness_command_deadline`: failed to report timeout → passed; additional checks verify reaping and output capture.
- `harness_large_case_rejects_refusal_and_wrong_count`: reproduced the old helper accepting refusal → passed with explicit import/count/export/re-import assertions.

Logs: [initial red](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/fix1-red.log), [sibling guard red](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/fix1-siblings-red.log), [corpus](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/fix1-oracle.log), [final gate](/home/admin/src/render-frontend-js/PALS-Notes/projects/ops/filmcraft-scene/agents/corpus/fix1-gate.log).

Final VM gate: formatting and Clippy passed; **313 tests passed, eight ignored**; 69 assets verified; 50 Wasm crates checked. The corpus intentionally exits unsuccessfully on the recorded product bugs. Integrator: dispatch those fixes and unignore their regressions when resolved. Coordination task completed and locks released.
